name: LIVE_EVENT_PERFORMANCE
comment: Per-event metrics for all live-ops events, 529 runs. Event catalogue present in this table: Axe Arena, Plague Race, River Rush, Season Pass, Streak Fever, Weekly Leaderboards, Weekly Quests, Win & Collect. Recorded incidents against these events -- 2024-11-15 Weekly Quests: Quest-system auto-deploy incident (ENG-1892); 2025-07-12 River Rush: Scheduler outage; 2025-08-05 Plague Race: Plague Race algo bug (ZOM-459).
